sections.heading: 1. People as a Resource — Human Capital
points: **'People as a resource'** = looking at the population as a **productive asset**, in terms of their **skills and abilities**.
**Human capital** = the stock of skill, knowledge and health in the population; investment in **education and health** turns people into human capital.
Human capital is superior to physical resources because people can **use** other resources.

sections.heading: 2. Economic and Non-economic Activities
points: **Economic activities** produce goods/services for **income** — divided into **market activities** (for pay/profit) and **non-market activities** (for self-consumption).
Activities are grouped into **primary, secondary and tertiary** sectors.
Much **unpaid work** (esp. by women at home) is economically valuable but not counted in national income.

sections.heading: 3. Quality of Population
points: **Education** raises productivity, incomes and national income; schemes: **Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan, mid-day meals, RTE**.
**Health** — a healthy person works better; measured by **life expectancy, infant mortality rate (IMR)**; India expanded healthcare.
A **skilled, educated, healthy** population is a nation's greatest asset.

sections.heading: 4. Unemployment
points: **Unemployment** = when people **willing and able to work** cannot find jobs.

sub: **Disguised unemployment** — more people work on a task than needed (common in agriculture); removing some would not reduce output.
**Seasonal unemployment** — no work during certain seasons (e.g. farming off-season).

points: Unemployment wastes human resources and increases dependence and poverty.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: 'People as a resource' = population as a productive asset (human capital).
Human capital built by investing in education & health.
Economic activities: market (for income) vs non-market (self-consumption); primary/secondary/tertiary.
Disguised unemployment = surplus workers (agriculture); seasonal unemployment = only in certain seasons.
Education & health raise productivity (SSA, RTE, mid-day meal).

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Disguised unemployment** = **too many** working on a job (removing some doesn't cut output) — common in farming.
**Seasonal unemployment** happens **only in certain seasons**.
**Human capital** is built by **education and health**.
Unpaid domestic work is valuable but usually **not counted** in national income.
